title: SRH processing at intermediate nodes
notes: BLOCKED 2026-08-26 after read-only parity audit; no files modified. Rust lichen-rpl/src/srh.rs likewise has codec + hop-limit predicate only. Implementing Rust alone would violate parity. Required convergence: fix/read-test Python compression/cycle/duplicate-header handling, add C intermediate processing or explicitly defer C under current phase, then implement Rust raw-packet intermediate transition with canonical cross-language vectors covering next-hop, Hop Limit, Segments Left, compression/padding, malformed/duplicate/loop, and 8-hop cap.
